channel.title: Botswana - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Botswana, every source cited.

item.title: Botswana launches P1 billion fund for industry
item.description: The Diamonds for Development Fund aims to convert mineral wealth into sustainable enterprises and jobs.

item.title: Botswana secures $503.75 million loan from AfDB
item.description: The new financing offers budget relief but raises questions about future revenue and debt repayment.

item.title: IDM Botswana graduates Class of 2026
item.description: The Institute of Development Management will hold its 20th Joint Graduation Ceremony on October 30, 2026, in Tlokweng.

item.title: Ukraine demands guarantees over captured Motswana
item.description: Botswana faces diplomatic hurdles in securing the release of a citizen fighting for Russia.

item.title: Botswana diamond workers allege exploitation
item.description: The Botswana Diamond Workers Union claims some firms pay meagre wages and force punishing hours on staff.
